review_audit.analysis: Workstream I.4 sequence diagram improperly executed XDEL immediately after XACK. In I.5, immediate XDEL is strictly prohibited. Stream entries are retained within a 24-hour / 50,000-message sliding window governed by MAXLEN ~ 50000 on XADD. This guarantees post-execution auditing and prevents message loss during PEL sweeps.

Unacknowledged worker claims remain tracked in PEL via XREADGROUP. A background supervisor monitors pending messages via XPENDING. If idle duration exceeds 60s, XAUTOCLAIM reclaims the entry under a new worker ID without duplicating the stream message.

When an entry's delivery attempts in PEL exceed 3 (tracked via XPENDING delivery count), it is copied to 'yorvyn:stream:dead_letter' with error metadata and acknowledged (XACK) in the primary stream to gracefully clear PEL.
